question: Which of the following structures belongs to the peritoneum ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "The greater omentum" -> "part of the peritoneum" -> 95%
CHAIN: "The dura mater" -> "part of the meninges" -> "not part of the peritoneum" -> 5%
CHAIN: "The pleura" -> "lines the thoracic cavity" -> "not part of the peritoneum" -> 5%
CHAIN: "The pericardium" -> "encloses the heart" -> "not part of the peritoneum" -> 5%
analysis: The peritoneum is a serous membrane that forms the lining of the abdominal cavity and covers most of the intra-abdominal organs. The greater omentum is a large fold of the peritoneum that hangs down from the stomach and covers the intestines. Therefore, the greater omentum is a structure that belongs to the peritoneum.
